faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in GSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Goa Staff Selection Commission has announced 215 tentative vacancies for Group C posts.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in Goa GSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts include Desktop Publishing Operator, Lower Division Clerk/Recovery Clerk, Data Entry Operator and Junior Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 02 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for GSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official Goa Staff Selection Commission website.

faq.question: Q5. When will the GSSC Recruitment 2026 exam be conducted?
faq.answer: The examination date will be intimated later through the Commission website and local daily.
